semantic_assessment.reason: All-target validated true-call mask and OR event inclusion are declared conditional assumptions. The package explicitly excludes automatically substituting OR for multiple-subclone ancestry-consistent callers. A simplified two-carrier-support component has probability 1/4 versus OR probability 3/4 under two independent 1/2 calls; neither computation replays a complete native caller.

Distinct true origins and known carrier membership are supplied, not discovered. Known empty carrier sets imply zero inclusion; unknown membership is refused. Missing or extinct uncatalogued events cannot be authenticated or reconstructed. Same carrier set can carry distinct catalogue events.

True all-target observability differs from isolation, outgrowth, sequencing and marginal stage fractions. A full supplied joint mask law is required for exact event inclusion, while individual true-call marginals yield only eventwise sharp union bounds. The sharp bounds do not constitute simultaneous freely chosen inclusion values for an arbitrary overlapping multi-event catalog.

Event inclusion and joint inclusion are dimensionless. Distinct-event counts, inherited target-copy counts and cells are separated. Union bounds have valid nested/circular interval witnesses. Joint event covariance follows from indicators; overlapping carriers can induce dependence even under independent descendant calls.

Expectation and variance condition on the fixed supplied catalogue, carrier sets and complete valid design law; positivity is required for every target event. No individual realization, mutation rate, unknown-catalog identification, estimated-probability correction, empirical variance estimator, CI, power, count-law admission or finite-sample coverage is claimed.

The route curvature 9/4 concerns normalized expected detected-event counts, not expected realized proportions. Own finite enumeration gives conditional mean realized shares (4/15,7/15,4/15), distinct from normalized means (2/7,3/7,2/7). The package explicitly labels normalized means and does not infer a biological causal effect.

All fixtures remain synthetic; actual system, catalog, route/axis, native observation predicate, independent controls, replicate units and error/stopping/count-law admission are unresolved. No actual 26-field study registry inputs are filled and no existing inference engine is calibrated.

Elementary indicator algebra, classical Frechet bounds and Horvitz-Thompson sampling are labeled established; no new theorem/priority claim. The sampling reference is explicitly Crossref bibliography-only, with no primary full-text acquisition or review.
